evidence: Added V100__create_architecture_network_zones_access.sql for network zones, external addresses, access applications/relations, and network zone columns on deployment unit, resource request item, and environment instance.
Added V101__seed_architecture_network_zones_access.sql for menus, permissions, grants, and default tenant-1 zones.
Added NetworkAccessModels, NetworkAccessStore, NetworkAccessService, and NetworkAccessController.
DeploymentUnitService validates and snapshots default network zone when present while preserving old overloads.
EnvironmentResourceService resolves explicit/request/default network zones and validates structured zones for new production flows.
MockAutomatedDeploymentProvider echoes network zone id/name into provision preview.
Added NetworkZonePage.vue and NetworkAccessPage.vue with route entries.
DeploymentUnitPage and DeploymentUnitDetailDrawer show and edit default network zone.
ResourceRequestPage uses network zone selectors for request items and fulfillment rows.
InstanceListPage displays structured network zone name with legacy text fallback.
Added NetworkAccessServiceTest for application snapshot, missing network zone rejection, and approval relation snapshot.
Ran required build and test commands; see observation.json.
Added V102__create_architecture_network_zone_subnets.sql with arch_network_zone_subnet and tenant-1 demo CIDR seeds.
Added NetworkCidr and NetworkZoneSubnet model/store/service/controller APIs under /api/architecture/network-zones/{zoneId}/subnets.
NetworkZonePage.vue now opens a subnet drawer for CIDR/gateway/purpose maintenance on active leaf zones.
EnvironmentResourceService requires manual fulfillment IPs to be inside the selected zone's active subnets.
MockAutomatedDeploymentProvider generates automated fulfillment addresses from ProvisionItemRequest.networkSubnetCidr.
NetworkAccessPage.vue now opens a read-only application detail drawer from the application number, desktop detail action, and mobile card title/footer.
The detail drawer renders application status, applicant, protocol/ports, purpose, validity, process description, timestamps, and source/target endpoint snapshots from the existing list DTO.
NetworkAccessPage.vue now opens read-only relation and external address detail drawers from desktop identity columns, operation actions, and mobile card title/footer.
Relation detail renders relation status, linked application id, protocol/ports, purpose, validity, close reason, timestamps, and source/target snapshots.
External address detail renders address type, value, status, purpose, remark, and timestamps while keeping edit/enable/disable actions permission-gated.
Added V103__seed_architecture_network_zones_from_reference_diagram.sql after the user approved the listed network partition data.
V103 seeds 13 P1/P2/P5/P8 root and leaf network zones plus 34 exact CIDR subnet rows from the diagram without manual direct database inserts.
P2_OFFICE_TERMINAL is seeded as a zone only; no subnet row was inserted because the diagram only marks the office computer range as 20-prefix without exact CIDR.

out_of_scope_kept: No real firewall, network device, CLB/DNS/certificate platform, external notification, scheduled reclaim, or attachment flow was implemented.
Existing CLB/DNS/certificate special network work orders remain separate and compatible.
